name: Settings
tip: Station identity, position, Bluetooth and media.

children.tip: Your position and how far around it to listen.

children.tip: Exchange short messages directly over Bluetooth, off-grid.

children.tip: Scan for and broadcast chat frames over BLE.

children.name: media
children.tip: Images shared in messages are fetched over the network.

children.name: media_auto_mb
